consequence.statement: A new API version is available; existing SecretStore versions are not stated to change.

original.statement: A new served API version external-secrets.io/v1 of the SecretStore kind was added; it is purely additive and requires no operator action.

decision.reason: [ev-f9a790bae7ab] and [ev-c92a1c2a1dd9] show that only one thing changed for this subject: a served external-secrets.io/v1 version was added to the SecretStore CRD, where 0.15.0 had none [ev-e653376afb3a]. Nothing in the evidence says that adding it makes anything fail, get rejected or need migration, so kind none (informational) is correct. The canonical validator also confirmed this. The rendered diff shows other changes to the same CRD: v1alpha1 removed [ev-04b0055709ca], v1beta1 no longer the storage version [ev-f07fad593227] and the conversion webhook removed [ev-728cc9a57b79]. Those are separate upstream changes and need their own assertions, not this consequence. That makes the proposal's wording "existing SecretStore versions are not stated to change" inaccurate.
